description: This file defines list processing functions and data structures for the FreeType project, including list management, node operations, and iteration mechanisms.

methods.name: FT_List_Find
methods.description: Finds a list node containing the specified data within a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Add
methods.description: Appends a node to the end of a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Insert
methods.description: Inserts a node at the beginning of a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Remove
methods.description: Removes a specified node from a list.

methods.name: FT_List_Up
methods.description: Moves a node to the head of the list, used for LRU management.

methods.name: FT_List_Iterate
methods.description: Iterates over list nodes, calling a user-defined function on each.

methods.name: FT_List_Finalize
methods.description: Destroys all list elements and the list itself, optionally using a destructor function.
